modbus.label: Modbus RTU example
modbus.summary: Modbus RTU master/slave example. Off by default; the user enables it and sets TX/RX/DE pins in the UI.
wiring: src/webserver/webserver.cpp: MODBUS, MODBUSPROFILE and MODBUSRAW handlers
remove: remove modbus.* and menu.modbus from vue/json/locales/ru.json and en.json
keep protocol keys: MODBUS, MODBUSPROFILE, MODBUSRAW
notes: Disabled by default: role = off, UART is not started until the user connects.
Pins are runtime settings in the UI (TX/RX/DE); DE -1 means auto-direction.
ESP32/C3 only: the module compiles on ESP8266, but the UART is not started there.
Template register map is generic: firmware/uptime/address/baud/role/errors/requests/RTC + slave bank 100–131.
